faqSection.title: Web & App Development
faqSection.subtitle: Common answers regarding our programming tech stack, mobile platform releases, and long-term application support.

items.question: Which tech stacks do you recommend for modern web development?
items.answer: We highly recommend React and Next.js for high-performance frontend interfaces due to server-side rendering (SSR), and Node.js/Python/Go for scalable backend microservices, along with PostgreSQL or MongoDB databases.

items.question: Do you develop native mobile apps or cross-platform solutions?
items.answer: We develop both. For most applications, cross-platform frameworks like Flutter and React Native offer exceptional native-like speeds while keeping build budgets and deployment timelines optimized. For graphics-intensive tasks, we deploy native Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android) code.

items.question: How do you ensure our application is SEO friendly?
items.answer: We construct web assets using Next.js server-side rendering, ensuring crawlers receive pre-rendered HTML content. We also optimize Core Web Vitals, implement structured Schema markup, build clean sitemaps, and design responsive page layouts.

items.question: Will we own the custom source code after deployment?
items.answer: Yes. Upon project completion and payment settlement, full ownership rights of the source code, repository control, and deployment environments are transferred directly to your organization.

items.question: What kind of post-launch maintenance do you offer?
items.answer: We offer structured Service Level Agreements (SLAs) including weekly security updates, cloud database backups, API version monitoring, layout repairs, and feature upgrades to adapt to operating system shifts.

items.question: How can we start a discovery session with your team?
items.answer: Please complete our contact form. A solution architect will contact you within 24 hours to schedule a Zoom or Google Meet call to discuss project goals, user personas, and budget estimates.
